genericity_statement: One governed vocabulary maps an internal role or state identifier to the warm, plain-English wording a Grade-9 learner actually reads. Internal identifiers are unchanged: schema fields, JSON enum values, falsifier names and test assertions keep using MISCONCEPTION_REPAIR, WORKED, GUIDED, EXECUTE and the rest. Only the rendered learner surface is translated, and it is translated here rather than in each renderer, so Core (1A) and Core (2) cannot drift into two different vocabularies.
